name: ci
display_title: fix(web): let a memory-only host change the draft model

head_commit.message:
fix(web): let a memory-only host change the draft model

`dsh web` runs without a data directory until a launch lease supplies one, and
two separate refusals made the official model dialog fail on such a host:

1. `activity.sessionActivity()` refused with `schedule/unavailable` whenever
   `host.dataDir` was undefined, and the Web owner's `draftBlockers()` treats a
   refusal as a hard stop, so every `session/selectModel` call ended in
   "Durable controlled task storage is unavailable".
2. `MemEventStore` numbered events with one store-wide counter starting at 1,
   while the durable stores number per session from 0. The draft-journal
   invariant in `assertDraft()` therefore rejected every memory-only draft as
   "A draft journal is not a dense immutable prefix" (`session/alias-corrupt`).

Read-only task queries now report "nothing pending" on a memory-only host
(real task mutations keep refusing with `schedule/unavailable`), and the memory
fake allocates per-session zero-based sequences exactly like `@ar/events` and
`@ar/store` already do.

Verified: a new `composition.integration.test.ts` case drives
`session/selectModel` on a memory-only host, `pnpm typecheck` passes, the
focused suites pass, and the real 8787 app selects an endpoint-discovered
model without the toast.
